# SnapshotPage

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

One rendered page's size and backdrop facts. `color` is the resolved page fill (a per-page `pageColor` overriding the document default); `backdropUnknown` marks a page that paints a background *element*, whose backdrop the contrast rules must not guess at.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Properties

- [`backdropUnknown`](#backdropunknown): The page paints a background element, so its backdrop is unmodellable.
- [`color`](#color): Resolved page fill, `"#rrggbb"`, when one is set.
- [`height`](#height): Page height, in points.
- [`width`](#width): Page width, in points.
